propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, fidelium remunerator animarum, qui hunc diem beati Apollinaris
Sacerdotis tui martyrio consecrasti: tribue nobis, quaesumus, famulis tuis;
ut, cujus venerandam celebramus festivitatem, precibus ejus indulgentiam
consequamur. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.text: O God, the rewarder of faithful souls, Who hast consecrated this day to the martyrdom of blessed Apollinaris, Thy priest, grant us, Thy servants, we beseech Thee, that, as we observe his venerable feast, we may obtain forgiveness through his prayers. Through our Lord.
